failure_policy.markdownDescription:
#### workflow.options.failure_policy

失败策略.

- `all_fail`: 任一 run 失败即失败
- `primary_only`: 失败 run 被跳过但 workflow 继续

##### 字段约束
- 必填: 否
- 类型: string
- 取值: `all_fail`, `primary_only`
- 默认值: `all_fail`

##### 例子
(兜底最小示例; 仅保证 schema-only 合法)
```yaml
all_fail
```

conflict_policy.markdownDescription:
#### workflow.options.cache_pool.conflict_policy

signature 冲突策略.

- `error`: 发现同一 `(kind, source_id)` 的 signature 不一致时直接失败
- `warn`: 允许冲突并继续(会发出 warning 事件,并附带 diff 摘要)
- `separate`: 允许冲突并继续(作为独立 entry 共存;当前实现与 warn 等价,仍会发 warning)

##### 字段约束
- 必填: 是
- 类型: string
- 取值: `error`, `separate`, `warn`

##### 例子
```yaml
    cache_pool:
      conflict_policy: error
      release_policy: dag_refcount
      budget:
        max_entries: 16
        over_budget_policy: fail_fast
      pin:
        - kind: preload_forever
          source_id: preload_counter
```

release_policy.markdownDescription:
#### workflow.options.cache_pool.release_policy

释放策略.

- `dag_refcount`: 当某 `(kind, source_id)` 的剩余 consumer=0 时释放(类似 DAG 引用计数)
- `workflow_end`: 直到 workflow 结束才释放(占用更久,但可能减少重复加载)

##### 字段约束
- 必填: 是
- 类型: string
- 取值: `dag_refcount`, `workflow_end`

##### 例子
```yaml
    cache_pool:
      conflict_policy: error
      release_policy: dag_refcount
      budget:
        max_entries: 16
        over_budget_policy: fail_fast
      pin:
        - kind: preload_forever
          source_id: preload_counter
```

max_entries.description: cache pool entry 数量预算(>=1).
max_entries.markdownDescription:
#### workflow.options.cache_pool.budget.max_entries

cache pool entry 数量预算(>=1).

over_budget_policy.markdownDescription:
#### workflow.options.cache_pool.budget.over_budget_policy

超限策略.

- `fail_fast`: 超限即失败
- `evict_lru`: 逐出 LRU 的 idle entry(仅逐出 refcount=0 且非 pin); 若无可逐出项则失败

##### 字段约束
- 必填: 是
- 类型: string
- 取值: `fail_fast`, `evict_lru`

##### 例子
```yaml
    cache_pool:
      conflict_policy: error
      release_policy: dag_refcount
      budget:
        max_entries: 16
        over_budget_policy: fail_fast
      pin:
        - kind: preload_forever
          source_id: preload_counter
```

kind.markdownDescription:
#### workflow.options.cache_pool.pin[*].kind

pin kind.

- `preload_forever`: pin 该 `(kind, source_id)` 的缓存(避免被 refcount/LRU 逐出)

##### 字段约束
- 必填: 是
- 类型: string
- 取值: `preload_forever`

##### 例子
```yaml
    cache_pool:
      conflict_policy: error
      release_policy: dag_refcount
      budget:
        max_entries: 16
        over_budget_policy: fail_fast
      pin:
        - kind: preload_forever
          source_id: preload_counter
```
